value-321.rule: For each stationary/moving group, pool each 32-frame window separately. Correct alignment X/Y/radial RMS limits = 1.25 * largest correct window across group phases + .000001; refuse any limit >= .125 render pixel (predeclared known shift defect). Correct foreground/background/edge/temporal MAE and texture NRMSE get the same selection formula and must still reject the analytic known defects. Each wrong control must exceed paired correct alignment RMS by >=10% plus .001 pixel in every window: X for negated-X, Y for negated-Y, radial for both/lagged/zero. Exploration is selection data only. Freeze limits before three fresh ordered confirmations; do not require every wrong input to lose every quality metric.
value-321.scope: Bounded spatial-phase and local quality/sensitivity confirmation; no universal quality or jitter policy
